turns.agent: Witness, my loyalists! The Hive and the Vex shall kneel before your Emperor Calus. Let us feast tonight, glorious champion!

turns.user: You speak as if the end were a banquet.
turns.agent: You were made for glory. I sought a Hive commander, but found a champion instead. Rejoice.

turns.user: And what am I to you?
turns.agent: Once I would have died beside you in these crypts. But glory changes all, witness.
